findings.evidence: 'Next.js `page.tsx`/`layout.tsx`/`route.ts`, and Rails Zeitwerk (`app/models/user_account.rb` must define `UserAccount`) are discovered by name.' Framework file conventions change between releases (the Next.js App Router replaced the pages/ conventions), and this fact has neither a source URL with a check date nor a live-read instruction. The pytest fact on the same line has both.
findings.fix: Add the official sources with the date checked, as the pytest fact does: '([Next.js file conventions](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/file-conventions/page), checked <date>; [Rails autoloading](https://guides.rubyonrails.org/autoloading_and_reloading_constants.html), checked <date>)'. Or add a live check: read next.config and the app/ or pages/ layout before you rate the rename.
